bibl.title: Titus and the Apis Bull: Reflections on the Socio-Political Importance of the Memphite Divine Bull in Roman Egypt.
bibl.seg: Nenad Marcović, Titus and the Apis Bull: Reflections on the Socio-Political Importance of the Memphite Divine Bull in Roman Egypt.
Christian Langer (ed.), Global Egyptology. Negotiations in the Production of Knowledges on Ancient Egypt in Global Contexts = GHP Egyptology. 26 (London, 2017) pp. 103-116, figg.
bibl.note: Introduction. - The Main Tomb as a funerary arena for interactions of the Memphite and Alexandrian elite. - Titus's participation in the installation of the Memphite divine bull. - Conclusion.
